notes.title: Demo Review (Patch)
notes.content:
We've added a number of changes and updates to the game to polish details so our players can enjoy a demo worthy of its title and free of errors.

We welcome any feedback if you find any errors!

Once the demo is complete, we'll begin developing the next chapters of Chaos of Destiny Remake.

notes.title: UPDATE: CHAPTER 2 ¡COMPLETED!
notes.content:
This is great news, as Chapter 2 of Chaos of Destiny: Remake is now fully realized. What does this mean? A playable demo will be available very soon and we will begin this grand adventure.
Keep your eyes peeled for upcoming updates and dive into ChaosWorld!
